items: **`for`** when you know the count, **`while`** when you do not, **`do...while`** when the body must run at least once.
Every loop needs three things: **initialise**, **test**, **update**. Missing the update is the classic infinite loop.
`do...while` requires a **semicolon** after the closing condition.
**`break`** exits the loop; **`continue`** skips to the next iteration. Both affect only the innermost loop.
In **nested loops**, the inner loop runs fully for every single outer iteration.
Watch `<` versus `<=`, one character, one whole iteration.
